hook: Deadly coronaviruses kill lung cells through necroptosis, and blocking it eased lung damage in mice.
hook_turn: and blocking it eased lung damage in mice.
summary: Highly pathogenic coronaviruses make Z-RNA, which switches on the ZBP1 sensor and a form of inflammatory cell death called necroptosis. Seasonal coronaviruses make little Z-RNA and do not trigger it. A small-molecule necroptosis inhibitor reduced cytokines and lung injury in infected mice without clearing the virus. Results come from cells and mice, so benefit in patients is untested.
title: Necroptosis is a targetable driver of severe coronavirus pathogenesis
